prompts: Use case: logo-brand. Create a square Telegram avatar for Premium Emoji App, an app for composing messages with animated premium emoji. Concept 1: a single delightful golden-yellow 3D emoji face, a confident friendly wink and broad small smile, with one elegant tiny four-point sparkle beside the upper cheek. Sculpted satin toy material, sophisticated rounded forms, subtle gold highlights. Deep dark charcoal background with a restrained violet ambient glow. Large central silhouette occupying 70 percent, all important details safely inside a circular crop. Readable at 48 pixels. High-end polished app icon artwork, joyful and approachable, not childish. No lettering, no words, no watermark, no border, no collage. Output one standalone square image.

Use case: logo-brand. Create a square Telegram avatar for Premium Emoji App, an app for composing messages with premium emoji. Concept 2: a single bold mint-green speech bubble with a simple friendly smiling face embedded into it, plus one small four-point mint-white sparkle touching its upper right edge. Modern sculpted soft 3D icon with clean substantial contours, almost flat front view, subtle dimensional edges and soft shadows. Dark charcoal backdrop consistent with a premium dark-mode messaging app. Mint and pale emerald dominant; crisp expressive contrast. Centered icon occupying 70 percent of the frame, generous safe margins for circular crop, recognizable at 48 pixels. No lettering, no words, no paper plane, no watermark, no extra objects, no collage. Output one standalone square image.

Use case: logo-brand. Create a square Telegram avatar for Premium Emoji App, an app for expressive premium emoji messages. Concept 3: one chunky four-point sparkle star made of luminous iridescent glass, pearlescent lavender, electric lilac and soft icy cyan, with two simple dark oval eyes and a tiny friendly smile, cheerful and elegant. A beautiful tactile 3D collectible emoji, minimal composition, smooth rounded points, controlled glossy highlights, deep dark charcoal background, a gentle compact violet halo directly behind the star. Large centered shape taking 70 percent of the frame; entire star and face fit safely in a circular crop. Icon must read clearly at tiny avatar size. No typography, no text, no letters, no watermark, no collage, no additional characters. Output one standalone square image.
